lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾਨੀ ਘਤਿ ਚਲਾਇਆ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਆਇਆ ਰੁੰਨੇ ਵੀਰ ਸਬਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaanee ghat chalaaiaa likhiaa aaiaa ru(n)ne veer sabaae ||
lines.translation: This dear soul is driven off, when the pre-ordained Order is received, and all the relatives cry out in mourning.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਂਇਆ ਹੰਸ ਥੀਆ ਵੇਛੋੜਾ ਜਾਂ ਦਿਨ ਪੁੰਨੇ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaa(n)iaa ha(n)s theeaa vechhoRaa jaa(n) din pu(n)ne meree maae ||
lines.translation: The body and the swan-soul are separated, when one's days are past and done, O my mother.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇਹਾ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤੇਹਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਜੇਹਾ ਪੁਰਬਿ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jehaa likhiaa tehaa paaiaa jehaa purab kamaaiaa ||
lines.translation: As is one's pre-ordained Destiny, so does one receive, according to one's past actions.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਸਿਰੰਦਾ ਸਚਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਗੁ ਧੰਧੈ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: dha(n)n sira(n)daa sachaa paatisaahu jin jag dha(n)dhai laaiaa ||1||
lines.translation: Blessed is the Creator, the True King, who has linked the whole world to its tasks. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈਹੋ ਸਭਨਾ ਏਹੁ ਪਇਆਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: saahib simarahu mere bhaaeeho sabhanaa ehu paiaanaa ||
lines.translation: Meditate in remembrance on the Lord and Master, O my Siblings of Destiny; everyone has to pass this way.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਥੈ ਧੰਧਾ ਕੂੜਾ ਚਾਰਿ ਦਿਹਾ ਆਗੈ ਸਰਪਰ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: ethai dha(n)dhaa kooRaa chaar dihaa aagai sarapar jaanaa ||
lines.translation: These false entanglements last for only a few days; then, one must surely move on to the world hereafter.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਗੈ ਸਰਪਰ ਜਾਣਾ ਜਿਉ ਮਿਹਮਾਣਾ ਕਾਹੇ ਗਾਰਬੁ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: aagai sarapar jaanaa jiu mihamaanaa kaahe gaarab keejai ||
lines.translation: He must surely move on to the world hereafter, like a guest; so why does he indulge in ego?

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਦਰਗਹ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਿਸੈ ਕਾ ਲੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jit seviai daragah sukh paaeeai naam tisai kaa leejai ||
lines.translation: Chant the Name of the Lord; serving Him, you shall obtain peace in His Court.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਗੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਚਲੈ ਮੂਲੇ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਿਆ ਵਿਹਾਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: aagai hukam na chalai moole sir sir kiaa vihaanaa ||
lines.translation: In the world hereafter, no one's commands will be obeyed. According to their actions, each and every person proceeds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਿਮਰਿਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈਹੋ ਸਭਨਾ ਏਹੁ ਪਇਆਣਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: saahib simarihu mere bhaaeeho sabhanaa ehu paiaanaa ||2||
lines.translation: Meditate in remembrance on the Lord and Master, O my Siblings of Destiny; everyone has to pass this way. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਥ ਸੋ ਥੀਐ ਹੀਲੜਾ ਏਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo tis bhaavai sa(n)mrath so theeai heelaRaa ehu sa(n)saaro ||
lines.translation: Whatever pleases the Almighty Lord, that alone comes to pass; this world is an opportunity to please Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਾਚੜਾ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: jal thal maheeal rav rahiaa saachaRaa sirajanahaaro ||
lines.translation: The True Creator Lord is pervading and permeating the water, the land and the air.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੋ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰੋ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: saachaa sirajanahaaro alakh apaaro taa kaa a(n)t na paaiaa ||
lines.translation: The True Creator Lord is invisible and infinite; His limits cannot be found.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਇਆ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਸਫਲੁ ਭਇਆ ਹੈ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਜਿਨੀ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: aaiaa tin kaa saphal bhaiaa hai ik man jinee dhiaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Fruitful is the coming of those, who meditate single-mindedly on Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਢਾਹੇ ਢਾਹਿ ਉਸਾਰੇ ਆਪੇ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhaahe dhaahi usaare aape hukam savaaranahaaro ||
lines.translation: He destroys, and having destroyed, He creates; by His Order, He adorns us.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਥ ਸੋ ਥੀਐ ਹੀਲੜਾ ਏਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੋ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jo tis bhaavai sa(n)mrath so theeai heelaRaa ehu sa(n)saaro ||3||
lines.translation: Whatever pleases the Almighty Lord, that alone comes to pass; this world is an opportunity to please Him. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰੁੰਨਾ ਬਾਬਾ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜੇ ਰੋਵੈ ਲਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak ru(n)naa baabaa jaaneeai je rovai laai piaaro ||
lines.translation: Nanak: he alone truly weeps, O Baba, who weeps in the Lord's Love.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਾਲੇਵੇ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਬਾਬਾ ਰੋਈਐ ਰੋਵਣੁ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਕਾਰੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: vaaleve kaaran baabaa roeeai rovan sagal bikaaro ||
lines.translation: One who weeps for the sake of worldly objects, O Baba, weeps totally in vain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੋਵਣੁ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਕਾਰੋ ਗਾਫਲੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੋ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਰੋਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: rovan sagal bikaaro gaaphal sa(n)saaro maaiaa kaaran rovai ||
lines.translation: This weeping is all in vain; the world forgets the Lord, and weeps for the sake of Maya.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚੰਗਾ ਮੰਦਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੂਝੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਏਵੈ ਖੋਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: cha(n)gaa ma(n)daa kichh soojhai naahee ihu tan evai khovai ||
lines.translation: He does not distinguish between good and evil, and wastes away this life in vain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਐਥੈ ਆਇਆ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਜਾਸੀ ਕੂੜਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: aithai aaiaa sabh ko jaasee kooR karahu aha(n)kaaro ||
lines.translation: Everyone who comes here, shall have to leave; to act in ego is false.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰੁੰਨਾ ਬਾਬਾ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜੇ ਰੋਵੈ ਲਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੋ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak ru(n)naa baabaa jaaneeai je rovai laai piaaro ||4||1||
lines.translation: Nanak: he alone truly weeps, O Baba, who weeps in the Lord's Love. ||4||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: vadaha(n)s mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Wadahans, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਵਹੁ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਸਹੇਲੀਹੋ ਸਚੜਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਏਹਾਂ ॥
lines.transliteration: aavahu milahu saheleeho sachaRaa naam laehaa(n) ||
lines.translation: Come, O my companions - let us meet together and dwell upon the True Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੋਵਹ ਬਿਰਹਾ ਤਨ ਕਾ ਆਪਣਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸੰਮੑਾਲੇਹਾਂ ॥
lines.transliteration: rovah birahaa tan kaa aapanaa saahib sa(n)mhaalehaa(n) ||
lines.translation: Let us weep over the body's separation from the Lord and Master; let us remember Him in contemplation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਮੑਾਲਿਹ ਪੰਥੁ ਨਿਹਾਲਿਹ ਅਸਾ ਭਿ ਓਥੈ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: saahib samhaalih pa(n)th nihaalih asaa bh othai jaanaa ||
lines.translation: Let us remember the Lord and Master in contemplation, and keep a watchful eye on the Path. We shall have to go there as well.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਲੀਆ ਹੋਆ ਤਿਸੈ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis kaa keeaa tin hee leeaa hoaa tisai kaa bhaanaa ||
lines.translation: He who has created, also destroys; whatever happens is by His Will.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤਿਨਿ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਆਇਆ ਅਸੀ ਕਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਕਰੇਹਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo tin kar paaiaa s aagai aaiaa asee k hukam karehaa ||
lines.translation: Whatever He has done, has come to pass; how can we command Him?

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਵਹੁ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਸਹੇਲੀਹੋ ਸਚੜਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਏਹਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: aavahu milahu saheleeho sachaRaa naam laehaa ||1||
lines.translation: Come, O my companions - let us meet together and dwell upon the True Name. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਮੰਦਾ ਲੋਕਾ ਆਖੀਐ ਜੇ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਐਸਾ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: maran na ma(n)daa lokaa aakheeai je mar jaanai aisaa koi ||
lines.translation: Death would not be called bad, O people, if one knew how to truly die.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਿਹੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਥੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਪੰਥੁ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ਆਗੈ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sevihu saahib sa(n)mrath aapanaa pa(n)th suhelaa aagai hoi ||
lines.translation: Serve your Almighty Lord and Master, and your path in the world hereafter will be easy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੰਥਿ ਸੁਹੇਲੈ ਜਾਵਹੁ ਤਾਂ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਆਗੈ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: pa(n)th suhelai jaavahu taa(n) phal paavahu aagai milai vadaaee ||
lines.translation: Take this easy path, and you shall obtain the fruits of your rewards, and receive honor in the world hereafter.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੇਟੈ ਸਿਉ ਜਾਵਹੁ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਹੁ ਤਾਂ ਪਤਿ ਲੇਖੈ ਪਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhetai siu jaavahu sach samaavahu taa(n) pat lekhai paaee ||
lines.translation: Go there with your offering, and you shall merge in the True Lord; your honor shall be confirmed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਹਲੀ ਜਾਇ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਖਸਮੈ ਭਾਵਹੁ ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ ਰਲੀਆ ਮਾਣੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: mahalee jaai paavahu khasamai bhaavahu ra(n)g siu raleeaa maanai ||
lines.translation: You shall obtain a place in the Mansion of the Lord Master's Presence; being pleasing to Him, you shall enjoy the pleasures of His Love.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਮੰਦਾ ਲੋਕਾ ਆਖੀਐ ਜੇ ਕੋਈ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਣੈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: maran na ma(n)daa lokaa aakheeai je koee mar jaanai ||2||
lines.translation: Death would not be called bad, O people, if one knew how to truly die. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਰਣੁ ਮੁਣਸਾ ਸੂਰਿਆ ਹਕੁ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਹੋਇ ਮਰਨਿ ਪਰਵਾਣੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: maran munasaa sooriaa hak hai jo hoi maran paravaano ||
lines.translation: The death of brave heroes is blessed, if it is approved by God.
